about: Every word of the spec's 2.9 the web makes, with its inputs: the look button, the record and the arm (Turntable.tsx's labels, read out of its source), the time line, the silent words and note, the fader's words (playSpeed.ts, SpeedFader.tsx, SpeedChip.tsx), You > Playback's labels and notes; debugRows.ts turntableRows and latencyNote over 41 DeckReports (null first), and speedRow - rows as [label, value, note].
made_by: ios/scripts/export-deck-vectors.cjs - never edit by hand: change the TypeScript and run it again

record.playing: The record: a tap pauses the song
record.paused: The record: a tap plays the song

words.notFlac: The record makes sound for FLAC songs only - this one moves silently.
words.noAudio: This browser can't make the record's sound - turning it still moves through the song.

notes.look: What you see first when you open Now Playing. The button at its top right switches between the two while it's open. For phones: a big screen has no Now Playing view.
notes.windDown: On the turntable, pausing slows the music to a stop over about a second, as a real record deck does. Turn it off to stop at once. Pausing from the cover always stops at once. For phones: a big screen has no turntable.
